The *Saṁkiliṭṭhaduka* ("Dyad on the Defiled") is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Dukapaṭṭhāna* section of the *Paṭṭhāna* (designated as Patthana 8.51) [SuttaCentral]. Following the categorical matrix of the Abhidhamma, it investigates causal conditioning and conditional relations (*paccaya*) with respect to states that are defiled (*saṁkiliṭṭha*) and those that are undefiled [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral does not record any English translation or curated parallel texts for this specific section [SuttaCentral].
